title: International Environmental Governance
definition: The organizational structure, legal frameworks, and policy processes through which the international community manages environmental issues and promotes sustainable development.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for GS Paper III (Environment) and GS Paper II (International Relations). Frequently tested via conventions, protocols, and institutional mandates.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of International Environmental Governance.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
